comment: MANUAL TAP/PAY, the accepting side (docs/design/viewer-manual-tap-pay.md). The human taps Kitchen for {U} by hand -- the board's ONLY blue source -- and the {1}{U} Cloud of Faeries is then paid off that float plus Conservatory's generic. CheckLine performs the tap FOR REAL on its state copy before the affordability walk (monotone-accepting doctrine), so this fixture is the statement that a hand-forced allocation is graded on the board it actually produces rather than on an optimistic model of it. #0 is the any-untapped-copy wildcard: a scenario board's m_numbers are not stable to author against, and the wildcard is the same one a hand-written line uses. MTG_HUMAN_PLAY is on because CheckLine and the whole pre-tap path are human-play-only -- without it the fixture would be vacuous. Its rejecting twins are edf_manual_tap_rejects_*.json.
